en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a bustling commercial street lined with two‑ and three‑storey colonial‑style buildings with wooden balconies. People in early 20th‑century dress walk and gather along the street; some appear to be local residents in traditional clothing and others in European attire. Shops occupy the ground floors, and signage is visible in French on the facades. In the foreground there is a low fence and many pedestrians, with the street receding into the distance between the buildings. Printed French text at the bottom identifies the scene as 'Rue du Commerce à Port Saïd'.
